name: propagate the error gradient backward through layers
mechanism: compute the output error, then pass it backward layer by layer multiplying by each layer's local derivative to obtain the gradient of the error with respect to every weight in one backward sweep, and adjust the weights against it

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Backpropagation' in section Computer science / Machine learning and statistical classification: a supervised learning method which requires a teacher that knows, or can calculate, the desired output for any given input

fails_when: vanishing or exploding gradients through many layers
